_comment: Run registry for the replay-run tracker. One entry per run. `segments` lists each training segment in cumulative order (a fresh start or a warm-start/resume each begin a new segment); cum_step = segment.cumstep_base + meta_step. elapsed_train_sec is pause-aware: it sums completed segment durations + time-into-current-segment, computed from [REPLAY] log timestamps, so stop/resume gaps are excluded. If a segment's log is missing, elapsed is left blank (by-step charts still render). Logs live in ~/Library/Logs/DrewsChessMachine. Models live in ~/Library/Application Support/DrewsChessMachine/Models. Order here is the chart/legend order.

nt8y15x15.label: nt8y-15x15stem — 1.73M, nt8y with 15×15 stem (std)
nt8y15x15.arch_summary: Preset nt8y_15x15stem (fresh 20260711-11-xE1v). Exactly nt8y but 15×15 stem (matches block conv kernel; nt8y's was 5×5). v5 · basic30(30) → stem 15×15→32 · 3×[15×15+15×15 @32, SE scale+bias/4, ReLU/pre, ReZero cap 0.333, LN-out] · policy intermediate_conv (pre-conv 512) · value WDL(16→FC64).
nt8y15x15.arch_blocks: 3× @32, 15×15+15×15, SE scale+bias/4, ReLU/pre, ReZero cap 0.333, LN-out

nt8y3x3s2.arch_summary: Preset nt8y_3x3stem, SECOND fresh seed (20260711-9-dOjG). Byte-identical arch to nt8y3x3 (seed1) — different random init only. v5 · basic30(30) → stem 3×3→32 · 3×[15×15+15×15 @32, SE scale+bias/4, ReLU/pre, ReZero cap 0.333, LN-out] · policy intermediate_conv (pre-conv 512) · value WDL(16→FC64). Seed-variance control vs nt8y3x3; runs to full 31.3h.
nt8y3x3s2.arch_blocks: 3× @32, 15×15+15×15, SE scale+bias/4, ReLU/pre, ReZero cap 0.333, LN-out

segments.label: m0.93
segments.note: base recovered from the wallclock bridge across segment 1, whose log is lost: seg0 last mark 2026-06-28T12:45:24 -> seg2 first mark 19:00:42 = 22518 s / 16901 steps = 1.332 s/step, matching the 1.325-1.329 measured in-segment rate to 0.4% (so ~90 s idle).
